messages:
anna.leung: Anyone else seeing missing child spans from service 'prefetcher-worker' in prod? Traces look like only the root/op shows up, no db/sql or http client spans for many requests. Not sure where to start looking.
devon.k: Which env + service name exactly? prod or prod-canary?
anna.leung: prod, service=prefetcher-worker. Started ~2 hours ago. Some traces show just the root and then nothing else.
jorge.g: Check if exporter changed. Our Grafana traces overview shows a drop at 16:10. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/TRACES/traces-overview (filter service=prefetcher-worker)
otel-bot: config-change: trace-sampling-rate set to 0.1 in prod at 2025-10-05T16:05Z by infra/ops (change-id: cfg-1293)
priya.sre: I applied a sampler tweak earlier to reduce load. Probabilistic sampler 0.1. That will drop a lot of short-lived spans. Can you confirm span durations?
devon.k: If spans are very short (db calls <10ms) prob sampler at 0.1 will make it look like nothing. Also check OTEL_PROPAGATORS — mixing tracecontext/b3 can drop child span correlation if libraries use different headers.
anna.leung: Good call. Where do I check OTEL props for this deployment?
devon.k: Helm values for prefetcher in infra repo: infra/values/prefetcher.yaml -> tracing.sampler.rate and tracing.propagators. You can also kubectl get deploy prefetcher-worker -n prod -o yaml and look at env.
anna.leung: quickly grepped the pod: shows OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=probabilistic and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.1 and OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext
jorge.g: We recently upgraded the DB client lib (dbx 2.0) last week — new version requires manual context attachment for some async helpers. If the instrumentation lib isn't compatible, child spans won't be created. Check instrumentation versions.
anna.leung: got it. I'll check requirements. In the meantime can we try a quick patch to increase sampling to 0.5 and enable b3 alongside tracecontext to catch propagation issues?
devon.k: Yep. Quick patch command you can run:
```
kubectl set env deployment/prefetcher-worker -n prod \
  OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=probabilistic \
  OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.5 \
  OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,b3
```
anna.leung: Doing that now, will canary for 10m and report back. /cc @devon.k
devon.k: I'll watch traces + logs. Loki query for errors: https://logs.redwood.example/loki/queries?query=%7Bjob%3D%22prefetcher-worker%22%7D%20|%3D%20%22error%22
anna.leung: deploy-bot started canary rollout with image sha=sha256:abc123 on 2 pods
deploy-bot: canary-rollout: prefetcher-worker -> 2/8 pods updated (canary)
anna.leung: After increasing sample rate I can now see some child spans for db/sql but still missing some http client spans. Will check instrumentation version and maybe add a small wrapper to attach context around async callbacks.
jorge.g: If you need a quick patch for the db client, add `with tracer.start_as_current_span` around the async callback entrypoint — old instrumentations sometimes drop the context.
anna.leung: thanks all, will monitor for 15m and post updates. If it looks good I'll open infra PR to make sampler 0.5 temporarily and add b3.
devon.k: :thumbsup: ping here when done and I can roll the rest or revert sampler back to 0.1 after we confirm.
anna.leung: update: 12m in, traces look back to normal for sampled traces. Closing for now, will file follow-up issue to align instrumentation versions + add integration test.
anna.leung: issue created: https://go.redwood.example/ISSUE-4832 (instrumentation mismatch causing missing child spans)
